select count(*) total,
 count(*) filter (where superseded_at is null) not_superseded,
 count(*) filter (where superseded_at is null and disappeared_at is null) current_all,
 count(*) filter (where superseded_at is null and disappeared_at is null and incentive_type='liquidity') current_liq,
 count(*) filter (where superseded_at is null and disappeared_at is null and incentive_type='liquidity' and (end_date is null or end_date > now())) current_liq_live,
 count(*) filter (where status_observed='paid_out' and superseded_at is null) paid_out_current,
 pg_size_pretty(sum(pg_column_size(raw_json))) raw_sz, pg_size_pretty(sum(pg_column_size(market_raw_json))) mkt_sz,
 (select max(started_at)::text from incentive_discovery_cycles) last_cycle, now()::text
from incentive_programs
